methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Energy baselines and performance energy indicators were determined using multivariable regression models and the equations specified in the energy planning guidelines of ISO 50001:2018.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study embarks on an energy review of Sabanalarga municipality in Colombia, scrutinizing its energy performance

level_3b.evidence_quote: The household and transportation sectors are the primary consumers of energy, accounting for 90% of the municipal energy consumption.

stage1.notes: Municipal energy review of one intermediate municipality (Sabanalarga, Colombia); residential/transport dominate. Not a continuous-process industry, so level_3b=false.

multi_site.evidence_quote: the developed methodology being put into practice within the municipality of Sabanalarga

country_region.evidence_quote: an energy review of Sabanalarga municipality in Colombia

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: Energy consumption is concentrated in the residential and transportation sectors, with a slight increase in the industrial sector in recent years.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: based on the methodology of ISO 50001:2018 for energy review

evidence_quote: A multivariable regression model is employed to establish the base equation for electricity consumption in the residential sector
